statements.quote: Cloud revenue increased 195%, or $635 million, in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to a 153% increase in exabytes sold due to increased enterprise SSD shipments to data center customers and a 17% increase in ASP per gigabyte due to improved pricing.
statements.notes: Cloud end-market revenue is attributed to enterprise SSD shipments to data center customers. The $635 million is a year-over-year increase, not a revenue level, and the 195% is a growth rate, not a share of revenue. Neither is recorded as an amount or share. No AI or data-center revenue figure is stated. Cloud segment is treated as data-center demand on the seller side, which is why confidence is reduced.
